deals.evidence: The Firm is representing Blackstone in connection with a definitive agreement under which private equity and real estate funds affiliated with Blackstone will acquire PSAV from affiliates of Goldman Sachs and Olympus Partners. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

deals.headline: Blackstone to Sell Intelenet for $1 Billion
deals.summary: Blackstone entities agreed to sell business process outsourcer Intelenet to a Teleperformance affiliate for an enterprise value of $1 billion.
deals.evidence: The Firm represented certain entities affiliated with The Blackstone Group L.P. in connection with an agreement to sell Intelenet for a total consideration (enterprise value) of $1 billion to an affiliate of Teleperformance SE.

deals.headline: Hilton Completes Secondary Sales and Share Repurchase as Blackstone Successfully Exits Hilton
deals.summary: Blackstone-affiliated holders sold their final 15.8 million Hilton shares in negotiated sales worth about $1.4 billion, plus a 1.25 million-share repurchase by Hilton, exiting Hilton.
deals.evidence: The Firm represented Hilton Worldwide Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HLT) in connection with secondary sales of 15,800,000 shares of common stock by certain selling stockholders affiliated with The Blackstone Group L.P. ... Based on the closing trading price on the NYSE on the pricing of the transactions, the shares sold represented approximately $1.4 billion.

deals.headline: Blackstone to Acquire LaSalle for $4.8 Billion
deals.summary: Blackstone agreed to acquire LaSalle Hotel Properties in an all-cash deal valued at $4.8 billion.
deals.evidence: The Firm is representing Blackstone in connection with its acquisition of LaSalle Hotel Properties (NYSE: LHO) in an all-cash transaction valued at $4.8 billion.

deals.headline: Blackstone to Acquire Gramercy Property Trust for $7.6 Billion
deals.summary: Blackstone agreed to acquire industrial REIT Gramercy Property Trust in an all-cash deal valued at $7.6 billion.
deals.evidence: The Firm is representing Blackstone in connection with its acquisition of Gramercy Property Trust (NYSE: GPT) in an all-cash transaction valued at $7.6 billion.

deals.headline: Blackstone to Acquire Cirsa
deals.summary: Blackstone private equity funds agreed to acquire Spanish gaming company Cirsa from founder Manuel Lao Hernández.
deals.evidence: Simpson Thacher is representing private equity funds managed by Blackstone in connection with their acquisition of Cirsa Gaming Corporation, S.A. from Mr. Manuel Lao Hernández.

deals.headline: Blackstone-Led Consortium Announces $20 Billion Partnership Agreement with Thomson Reuters
deals.summary: A Blackstone-led consortium with CPP Investments and GIC agreed to take 55% of Thomson Reuters' Financial & Risk business at an overall $20 billion valuation, Thomson Reuters keeping 45%.
deals.evidence: Under the partnership agreement, the Blackstone-led consortium will own 55% of the equity in a new corporation created to hold the F&R business and Thomson Reuters will retain a 45% equity stake, at an overall valuation of $20 billion.

deals.headline: Gates Completes $841 Million Initial Public Offering
deals.summary: Gates Industrial completed its NYSE IPO of 44.3 million shares at $19 each, raising gross proceeds of over $841 million.
deals.evidence: Simpson Thacher represented Gates Industrial Corporation plc in connection with its initial public offering of 44,275,000 ordinary shares (including shares sold pursuant to the underwriters’ exercise in full of their over-allotment option) at a public offering price of $19 per share, which raised gross proceeds of over $841 million.

deals.headline: Blackstone to Acquire Pure Industrial Real Estate Trust for C$3.8 Billion
deals.summary: Blackstone agreed to acquire Pure Industrial Real Estate Trust in an all-cash deal valued at C$3.8 billion including debt.
deals.evidence: The Firm is representing Blackstone in connection with its acquisition of Pure Industrial Real Estate Trust (“PIRET”) in an all-cash transaction valued at C$3.8 billion including debt.

deals.headline: Blackstone to Acquire Hotel Investment Partners
deals.summary: Blackstone Real Estate Partners agreed to acquire Spanish coastal hotel owner HI Partners from Banco Sabadell for EUR 630.7 million.
deals.evidence: Simpson Thacher is advising Blackstone Real Estate Partners V in connection with its acquisition of Hotel Investment Partners (“HI Partners”), a subsidiary of Banco Sabadell, for €630.7 million (US$744.2 million).

deals.seller: Bain Capital Private Equity; Oaktree Capital Management
deals.headline: Blackstone to Acquire International Market Centers
deals.summary: Blackstone Real Estate Partners and Tactical Opportunities funds agreed to acquire showroom operator International Market Centers from Bain Capital and Oaktree, with Fireside Investments expected to partner.
deals.evidence: Simpson Thacher is representing funds managed by Blackstone Real Estate Partners and Blackstone Tactical Opportunities in connection with their entrance into a definitive agreement to acquire International Market Centers, Inc. (“IMC”) from Bain Capital Private Equity, L.P. and funds managed by Oaktree Capital Management, L.P. Fireside Investments is also expected to partner with Blackstone in connection with the acquisition.

deals.headline: Blackstone to Sell Logicor to China Investment Corporation for €12.25 Billion
deals.summary: Blackstone agreed to sell its pan-European logistics company Logicor to China Investment Corporation for EUR 12.25 billion.
deals.evidence: Simpson Thacher is representing Blackstone in the announced sale of its pan European logistics company, Logicor, to China Investment Corporation for €12.25 billion.

deals.seller: Providence Equity Partners; Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan
deals.headline: Blackstone and Canada Pension Plan Investment Board to Acquire Ascend Learning
deals.summary: Blackstone and CPP Investments agreed to acquire education content and software provider Ascend Learning from Providence Equity and Ontario Teachers'; terms were not disclosed.
deals.evidence: The Firm is representing Blackstone and Canada Pension Plan Investment Board in connection with their announced acquisition of Ascend Learning, LLC (“Ascend Learning”) from private equity funds advised by Providence Equity Partners and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan. ... Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

deals.headline: Blackstone to Invest in Industrie De Nora S.p.A.
deals.summary: Blackstone entities agreed to acquire a substantial minority stake in Italian electrode and water technology maker Industrie De Nora.
deals.evidence: Simpson Thacher is representing The Blackstone Group (“Blackstone”) in connection with its investment in Industrie De Nora S.p.A. (“De Nora”), a leading global designer, manufacturer and supplier of electrode and water technologies. Entities affiliated with Blackstone will acquire a substantial minority stake in De Nora.

deals.headline: Blackstone Sells 21% Equity Interest in SeaWorld to Zhonghong
deals.summary: Blackstone agreed to sell its roughly 21% stake in SeaWorld to Zhonghong Group at $23 per share, fully exiting SeaWorld.
deals.evidence: The Firm is representing Blackstone in connection with its sale of an approximate 21% equity interest in SeaWorld to Zhonghong Group at a price of $23 per share. ... Following the closing, Blackstone will no longer hold any interests in SeaWorld or have seats on SeaWorld’s Board of Directors.

deals.headline: Blackstone to Acquire Tradesmen International
deals.summary: Blackstone agreed to acquire construction staffing firm Tradesmen International from Wellspring Capital affiliates; terms were not disclosed.
deals.evidence: The Firm is representing Blackstone in connection with its announced acquisition of Tradesmen International, LLC (“Tradesmen”) from affiliates of Wellspring Capital Management LLC. ... Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

deals.headline: Blackstone to Acquire Acetow
deals.summary: Blackstone private equity funds agreed to acquire cellulose acetate tow maker Acetow from Solvay for an enterprise value of around EUR 1 billion.
deals.evidence: Simpson Thacher is representing private equity funds managed by Blackstone in connection with their acquisition of Acetow from Solvay for an enterprise value of around €1 billion.

deals.headline: Blackstone to Sell Optiv to KKR
deals.summary: Blackstone agreed to sell cybersecurity firm Optiv to KKR, keeping a minority interest alongside management.
deals.evidence: The Firm is representing Blackstone (NYSE: BX) and Optiv Security in connection with Blackstone’s sale of Optiv to KKR (NYSE: KKR). Blackstone will maintain a minority interest in Optiv, along with Optiv management.

deals.investor: Blackstone Real Estate Partners Europe IV
deals.headline: Blackstone to Acquire OfficeFirst
deals.summary: Blackstone Real Estate Partners Europe IV agreed to acquire German office real estate business OfficeFirst Immobilien from IVG.
deals.evidence: The Firm is representing Blackstone Real Estate Partners Europe IV in connection with the announced acquisition of OfficeFirst Immobilien AG, a leading office-focused German real estate business, from IVG Immobilien AG.

deals.headline: Team Health to Be Acquired by Blackstone
deals.summary: Blackstone funds and co-investors agreed to acquire physician staffing company Team Health for $43.50 per share in a deal valued at about $6.1 billion.
deals.evidence: Simpson Thacher is representing Team Health Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TMH) in connection with its proposed sale to funds affiliated with Blackstone and certain co-investors in a transaction valued at approximately $6.1 billion. Under the terms of the agreement, Blackstone and its co-investors will acquire all of the outstanding shares of Team Health common stock for $43.50 per share in cash.

deals.headline: Blackstone Sells 25% Equity Interest in Hilton for $6.5 Billion
deals.summary: Blackstone agreed to sell an approximately 25% stake in Hilton to HNA Group in a transaction valued at about $6.5 billion, cutting its holding to about 21%.
deals.evidence: The Firm is representing Blackstone in connection with its sale of an approximate 25% equity interest in Hilton Worldwide Holdings Inc. to HNA Group. ... The transaction is valued at approximately $6.5 billion, reducing Blackstone’s interest in Hilton to approximately 21%.

deals.headline: Blackstone Sells Strategic Hotels
deals.summary: Blackstone sold most of Strategic Hotels to Anbang Insurance Group, after acquiring it in a $6 billion take-private the previous year.
deals.evidence: The Firm represented Blackstone in connection with its sale of most of Strategic Hotels to Anbang Insurance Group.

deals.headline: Blackstone to Make Equity Investment in JDA Software
deals.summary: Blackstone agreed to make an equity investment in supply chain software company JDA Software, with majority owner New Mountain Capital participating.
deals.evidence: Simpson Thacher is representing entities affiliated with The Blackstone Group L.P. (“Blackstone”) in connection with its announced equity investment in JDA Software Group, Inc. (“JDA”). JDA’s current majority shareholder, affiliates of New Mountain Capital LLC (“NMC”), will participate in the equity investment, too.

deals.headline: Blackstone Leads Series D Financing for Cylance Inc.
deals.summary: Blackstone Tactical Opportunities led the initial closing of cybersecurity company Cylance's $100 million Series D round.
deals.evidence: The Firm is representing Blackstone Tactical Opportunities in connection with its role as lead investor in the initial closing of a $100 million Series D funding round for Cylance Inc.

deals.headline: Carrix Acquires Ceres Terminals
deals.summary: Marine terminal operator Carrix bought Ceres Terminals from Macquarie Infrastructure Partners III.
deals.evidence: Simpson Thacher represented Carrix, a leading marine terminal operator in the U.S. and the Americas, in the debt financing for Carrix’s purchase of Ceres Terminals (“Ceres”) from Macquarie Infrastructure Partners III.

deals.headline: Chamberlain Group Acquires MFP-Nova

deals.evidence: Simpson Thacher represented The Chamberlain Group LLC (“Chamberlain Group”) in connection with its acquisition of Multi-Fab Products-Nova Technology, Inc. ("MFP-Nova"). The transaction closed on December 31, 2024.

deals.headline: Sphera to Acquire riskmethods
deals.summary: Blackstone-owned Sphera agreed to acquire supply chain risk management software company riskmethods; terms were not disclosed.
deals.evidence: The Firm is representing Sphera, a portfolio company of investment funds affiliated with Blackstone Inc. (NYSE: BX), in connection with its announced definitive agreement to acquire riskmethods. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

deals.summary: Pet care marketplace Rover agreed to go public by merging with True Wind Capital-sponsored SPAC Nebula Caravel at an implied enterprise value of about $1.35 billion, with a $50 million PIPE.

(Nasdaq: NEBC) ("Caravel"), a special purpose acquisition company sponsored by True Wind Capital, in connection with entering into a definitive business combination agreement with A Place for Rover, Inc. ("Rover") ... The transaction reflects an implied pro-forma enterprise value for Rover of approximately $1.35 billion.

deals.headline: Jersey Mike’s Prices Landmark IPO
deals.summary: Jersey Mike's Subs priced what was described as the largest US restaurant IPO in history, with its Class A shares set to trade on the NYSE as JMKE from July 30, 2026.
deals.evidence: Simpson Thacher advised Jersey Mike’s Subs Inc. on the largest U.S. restaurant IPO in history. Jersey Mike’s Class A common stock will begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange on July 30, 2026 under the ticker symbol “JMKE”.
